title: Sieur de Joli, minister at Montauban → Monsieur de Valançay and others, intercepted or copied letters on Soubise and Rohan, French copies partly deciphered
correspondents: Sieur de Joli (minister at Montauban) → Monsieur de Valançay and others; one letter to his brother in Milan
place: Montauban (as the catalogue gives the writer's post; place of writing not stated)
shelfmark: London, Lambeth Palace Library, MS 3473 (Fairhurst Papers, MS 3470-3533), f. 97
folio_note: One folio (f. 97) in a file of 223 ff.; the catalogue does not say how much of it is cipher or how much is deciphered
status: Lambeth CalmView file-level description, read 13 Nov 2026: "Letters from the Sieur de Joli, minister at Montauban, to Monsieur de Valançay and others, December 1623, concerning the activities of Soubise and the Duc de Rohan. Also a letter to his brother in Milan (French copies partly decyphered) (f.97)". The leaf was not seen: no image online. Not on DECODE (searches Lambeth, Montauban: 0 records). Kept only because the decipherment is described as partial; it may turn out to be complete for all that matters, or the copies may carry no ciphertext at all (a deciphered copy with gaps).
why: Huguenot correspondence from Montauban on Soubise and Rohan a year before the 1625 rising, as it reached an English secretary's papers (the file holds papers addressed to Beaulieu in London).
score_note: Scored from the archive description during the 13 Nov 2026 Lambeth sweep (research/sweep_2026-11-13_lambeth/); not viewed
